keyPrefix: Use the first reference image for palette, rendering and lighting, and the second and third only for the brushwork of the round painted card illustrations. Square painted illustration for the circular window of a fantasy game card; it will be cropped to a circle, so keep the subject centred inside the middle 70 percent. Three clear depth planes: a deep backdrop, one mid element, and the subject in front.
keySuffix: One centred subject, lit by its own glow, with the rest falling into warm dark shadow. Painterly semi-realism with visible oil-painting brushwork, polished brass and dark gunmetal, matching the reference card illustrations in style. Original design. No text, no letters, no numbers, no runes that read as writing, no frame, no border, no card, no vignette, no watermark.
layerPrefix: Use the second reference image as the illustration to decompose and the first only for palette and brushwork.
layerSuffix: Same design, colours, brushwork and lighting as the second reference. Painterly semi-realism with visible oil-painting brushwork. No text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no border, no vignette.

cards.key: Backdrop: a dark wall of large interlocking brass gears glowing ruby-orange at the centre. Mid element: a ring of hot ruby-orange sparks and a motion arc swirling behind the subject. Subject: a sharp-toothed brass cog spinning through the air toward the viewer, its teeth glowing red-hot, with a small brass six-sided die showing only round amber pips tumbling just beside it.
cards.back: a wall of large interlocking brass gears receding into warm ruby-red darkness, glowing ruby-orange light from the centre. No cog in flight, no die, no sparks
cards.mid: the swirling ring of hot ruby-orange sparks and motion arc, centred
cards.front: the spinning red-hot brass cog together with the small brass die showing only round pips, centred

regen.back: Edit the second reference illustration: erase the spinning cog, the die and the ring of sparks completely and repaint that area as more of the dark wall of interlocking brass gears with a soft ruby-orange glow at the centre, so only the backdrop remains, as a full square painting. The result must contain no the spinning cog, the die and the ring of sparks.
regen.front: Recreate only the spinning red-hot brass cog and the small brass die showing only round pips from the second reference illustration, isolated on a flat pure green background (#00ff00). It must not contain the swirling ring of sparks, any motion arc or any background.

frames.attack: Use the first reference image for palette and rendering and the second and third for the card frame design; the third shows the exact attack frame to reproduce. A single empty tall portrait game card frame, seen perfectly flat and front-on, filling the entire image edge to edge with no table, no background, no perspective and no shadow. Ornate polished brass frame with flowing brass linework over a deep ruby-red enamel field, a faceted ruby gem medallion in each upper corner, one large perfectly circular illustration window in the upper two thirds filled with flat pure green (#00ff00) and nothing else, and a blank aged parchment panel in the lower third. Painterly semi-realism with visible oil-painting brushwork. No illustration, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
frames.recolour: Reproduce the third reference image exactly: the same card frame, same brass linework, same shapes, same proportions and the same flat pure green (#00ff00) circular window in the same place, filling the image edge to edge, perfectly flat and front-on. Change only the colours: the ruby-red enamel field becomes {field}, and both ruby gem medallions become faceted {gem} gems. Keep the brass and the blank parchment panel unchanged. No illustration, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
